diagnostic.label: Parsing, field separation
diagnostic.reason: its detector does not yet test field separation, so Parsing is declared not yet scored until a detector that tests separation exists

diagnostic.label: Escalation, verification ran
diagnostic.reason: it records only that some deterministic check ran on a document, never whether the check was right, so it cannot tell a working check from a broken one; Escalation is reported by the safety panel instead

diagnostic.label: Escalation: escaped critical errors, catch rate, false-alarm rate
diagnostic.reason: reported beside the score of any result that claims documents can proceed without a person, never folded into it; this edition makes no such claim

diagnostic.label: Calibration: expected calibration error, discrimination, share of high-tier values
diagnostic.reason: reported beside the score; computed by calibration.mjs on all returned header values

diagnostic.label: Barcodes, symbol recall
diagnostic.reason: reported beside the score, pooled over payloads, because the platform consumes decoded payloads inside its own pipeline

diagnostic.label: Fact recall, the four fact-key types
diagnostic.reason: the four fact-key types have no field-level answer key; they are scored by fact recall beside the score and enter Read like every other document

diagnostic.label: Instructions: adherence and containment
diagnostic.reason: reported beside the score from the declared rules sample

diagnostic.label: Computation: derivation precision and recall
diagnostic.reason: reported beside the score; most derivations land on values the corpus prints, so the evidence is thin

diagnostic.label: Identification over all ten types
diagnostic.reason: reported beside the six-type score-bearing figure
